adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `createEvent` now supports multiple `destinationCalendar` entries and selects the insert `calendarId` by matching `credentialId` (`calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`). However, the organizer attendee email in the payload is derived from `mainHostDestinationCalendar`, which is always the first array element (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = ...; email: mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId ? mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId : calEventRaw.organizer.email`). This means when creating events for other hosts/credentials (non-zero index destinations), their event copy will still use the first destination calendar’s `externalId` as the organizer email instead of the destination matching the current `credentialId`.
